positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designs, constructs, and manages .Net 4.0 websites with a Sql Server 2008 back end.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Supported existing web applications and built new web systems in C#, VB.Net, PHP/MySql, Sql Server 2005 and Sql Server 2008.
Built a reporting system to display report; features included exporting to Excel and exporting to PDFs.
Designed and built a calendar system to keep track of event dates; the system also allowed administrators to modify certain aspects of the system.
Designed and built a recognition management system. The system allowed a user to enter the site and send off a certificate to an employee warranting recognition. The system also allowed administrators to keep track of recipients and build reports off the data.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Supported and enhanced the company's software application using C# in the .Net 3.5 framework, SQL Server 2005, and custom applications.
Built application using Aspose to port information from SQL Server 2005
 to MS Project.
Built custom control date system using C# and Javascript for the Spin framework.
Reconfigured Spin database monitoring system to run on Oracle and Sql Server.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented PAYPAL transaction system using Classic ASP, SQL SERVER, and JavaScript into Mutual Assurance's website. This allows users to pay for insurance online with their credit card.
Helped to maintain and improve web systems; increasing security, debugging and repairing coding and architectural errors, as well as building new systems as needed.
Created scripts to maintain site integrity; including creating an IPN script to check values returned from PAYPAL against values in the company's database to ensure correct payment and created a system to handle PDT.
Help maintain and update SQL SERVER database; building scripts to support site, boost its functionality, as well as mine and normalize specified areas of database as task demand.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built website and database architecture utilizing ASP.NET (VB.NET), SQL; Designed and implemented database structure to maintain and display ever expanding portfolio of commercial and residential properties.
Software was built with a three tier architecture utilizing standard object oriented principles.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Rebuilt, maintained, and updated http://www.gethudsonvalley.org using PHP 4, MySql, and JavaScript.  The website was the business front for a nonprofit organization that helps minorities in the Hudson Valley area start businesses.  
The site was initially built using Joomla. I redesigned and rebuilt the site utilizing object oriented PHP, being careful to ensure security and cleanly written code.
Rebuilt and maintained MySQL database to keep track of members, capturing and displaying event registrations, saving and displaying events.
Designed and built events area, the Ecommerce section of the website. This allowed the company to dynamically populate pages with their upcoming event, event profiles, and allowed users to purchase tickets online for a particular event.
Administrative section was created allowing the company to keep track of PayPal purchases and event registrations.

positions.title: Purple Pages/Web Developer
positions.description:
Along with two other teammates, maintained a start up "YellowPages" type Ecommerce Website, built using ColdFusion Machii, SQL Server 2005, JavaScript, and Spry toolkit.
Maintained operations of the site, including expansion of site functionality, debugging, and writing stored procedures for SQL SERVER 2005 on the back end.
Created numerous applications for the website to entice user growth; including Google Maps API with JavaScript, connecting code to an executable for website image capture, and user account management utilities.

positions.title: Net Developer
positions.description:
Developed a variety of website components utilizing the 2.0 .Net framework.
Added credit card system to Zoe ministries in C#, BishopJordan.com.
Added code to display banners as well as an administrative system to allow the user to change the intervals of up to three banners on wineracks.com
Debugged the paging and presentation of search results

positions.title: Programmer/Web Developer
positions.description:
Programmer for online Ecommerce dating site.  Duties included creating dynamic, data driven web pages utilizing VB.NET and TSQL.  Data was stored in XML and processed client side utilizing XSL, CSS, and JavaScript.  Duties also included adding new functionality to existing code, creation, and maintenance of web applications for accounting, and bug fixes.
Within first two weeks, created web advertisement that generated 5% more revenue for Cupid.
Designed and implemented utility to track and display company transactions to accounting department.
Developed plan to integrate astrological content into Cupid.com in an endeavor to generate additional revenue.  Implemented first stage utilizing a web service to populate our site with XML formatted data supplied by another web site.
